method: Raw per-replicate log2((RNA+.5)/(DNA+.5)); interaction A-A0-R+R0, averaged across cells; mean within each two- or three-repeat pool.
comparison: All ten two-versus-three-repeat splits, no shared replicate indices within split. Models are scored against each side; average the 20 correlations within each locus. Repeat reference is average of ten between-pool correlations within locus.
target_caveat: Both predictions and reference target cell-mean interaction. Reference includes measurement error on both sides; models only on target side. Thus the reference is a reproducibility benchmark, not a model ceiling.
pooling_dependence: The ten splits overlap with each other; they are not treated as independent samples. Uncertainty resamples whole loci only.
selection: No effect-strength selection. Original114 full paired loci and68026 queries. Distance calculated from background SNP position99; query cannot coincide with background SNP.
model_protocol: Original frozen predictions used in Fig4A/C and historical summary, no re-fitting; original supervised heads remain trained on canonical labels with complete-element holdouts.
changes: Evaluation target estimator and replicate pooling differ from published post_log2Skew labels. Canonical scores are replayed alongside; historical endpoints untouched.
correlation_handling: Within-locus Spearman. Fewer than2 cases or constant vector: undefined, excluded from macro mean as canonical evaluator. All missing counts reported.
